title: Oracle rating downgraded by S&P, now stands one notch above junk; reason is Sam Altman
description: S&P Global Ratings lowered Oracle's credit rating to BBB- from BBB.  The agency cited significant risks associated with Oracle's expanding AI infrastructure business.  OpenAI's substantial reliance on Oracle's services presents a key credit risk for the company.  Oracle faces potential financial strain from massive data center leases if OpenAI defaults.  The rating agency warned of further downgrades if leverage exceeds 4.5x.

title: How Karnataka put eggs on the school menu, 6 days a week
description: Karnataka's midday meal program now regularly includes eggs for many students.  Around sixty-five percent of children opt for eggs, with bananas as an alternative. Financial support from states remains a key challenge for wider implementation.
